culture.text: Brews Budweiser, Corona, Stella Artois, Beck's, Hoegaarden, Leffe and Jupiler, with about 137,000 colleagues in nearly 50 countries.
Describes a culture of collaboration and candour with open communication.
Headquartered in Leuven, Belgium; staff often studied at FGV, KU Leuven and Tecnológico de Monterrey, mostly in business and engineering.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor in the Netherlands.

growth.text: Staff fell from 169,339 in 2021 and 166,632 in 2022 to about 136,800 in 2025.
In 2025 revenue was US$59.32 billion and net profit US$8.477 billion.
Raised its profit growth outlook at its investor day.

worth_knowing.text: Its business in China has gone from growth market to problem area.
